extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors/editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia page when a searched title does not exist (e.g., 'Improv workshop'). Covers account requirements, searching existing content, redirects, recent-creation delays, and deleted-page checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Improv workshop" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' to find related pages that may cover the topic or provide context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created page visibility delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow time for database updates or use the purge function to refresh; do not immediately recreate a page that may already exist but isn't visible yet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, where appropriate, create redirects rather than duplicate articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted pages — check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult deletion logs and deletion-reason documentation before attempting to recreate content that may have been removed for policy reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For users who are not autoconfirmed or who prefer review, submit a draft via the article wizard or use the request-new-article process instead of directly creating a live page.
